what: A dark panel’s center image (silhouette · logo) is cut into six horizontal strips (18 · 19 · 16 · 12 · 17 · 18%) stacked at .16 opacity (.26s power4.out), and from .3s later each strip jitters sideways in its set order (up to 54/465 of the image width) and snaps back, repeating with a .25s rest between glitches. The greeting rises from 115% below over 2.1s after .85s, and the progress bar follows the smaller of the ready share and a minimum of 1.2s at a .14 ratio. When full, the strips turn opaque and snap into place offset ±3~9px (.34~.38s, .76,0,.24,1), hold for .7s, then the text vanishes in .22s and the image flattens to .025x vertically (.38s, .87,0,.13,1), and .34s later a background-color strip opens from a 3px line (.08s) to the full screen (.5s). When done the panel leaves and fx:loaded

options.min: Minimum length (sec) for the progress bar to fill, default 1.2
options.hold: Dwell time after snapping into place (seconds), default .7 — 0 for frequently opened screens
options.wait: Ready-signal event name — if given, the bar does not fill completely until that event arrives on document (up to 6 seconds)
options.every: If present, every time it opens (not just once)
options.[data-fx-part=art]: Graphic to cut (svg·img) — cloned into six copies, one copy shown per strip
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: (optional) progress bar — the part fills it with horizontal scale
